name: VLC for PS5
description: Native VLC media player port for PS5 homebrew with a controller-first interface. Plays H.264, HEVC, AV1, VP9, VC-1 and many other formats up to 4K, with subtitles, playlists, SMB and DLNA network shares, HLS/DASH streams, IPTV, internet radio, DVD and Blu-ray support, music playback and phone or PC remote access.
author: ZiZc3
